title: Question about the calculation of ZTpredBG:
symptom: The user asks why, in the glucose prediction module, only the ZT prediction does not calculate predDev, while IOB, COB, and UAM do.
cause: ZTpredBG is not intended to capture short-term inertia; it is meant to visually show how much BG should be dropping from predicted insulin activity alone if carb absorption were to suddenly cease.
evidence_quote: The ZTpredBG isn't intended to capture such short-term inertia: it's intended to visually show how much BG "should" be dropping from predicted insulin activity alone (if carb absorption were to suddenly cease)
